title: Dataverse _meta.dv.metadata.yaml
description: Entry point of a Dataverse metadata-as-code model: publisher, optional project code, target solution and base language.

version.description: Format version of the model files.

prefix.description: Publisher customization prefix — permanent, 2-8 lowercase alphanumeric characters.

project_code.description: Optional project code. When set, tables and global Choices must be named {prefix}_{project_code}_… (shared environments). Columns never carry it.

solution.description: Unique name of the target unmanaged solution in the dev environment.

locale.description: Base language of Display Names and Descriptions (the environment's primary language).
